findings.summary: The four named pressures lost their mechanisms.

evidence.baseline: the professionalization pressure, in which the growing institution requires people with professional skills that are available primarily from people whose professional formation occurred in institutions with different values; the growth pressure, in which the legitimate desire to serve more people creates momentum toward accepting compromises that would have been rejected at smaller scale; the complexity pressure ...; and the legitimacy pressure ...

findings.diagnosis: Each pressure names who exerts it and why it is legitimate, which is what makes them hard to resist and what distinguishes them from adversaries. The professionalization mechanism in particular, that skilled people were formed in institutions with different values, is a claim the volume makes nowhere else and that a founding team would need to plan around.

The four pressures with their mechanisms, the mirror-image framing against Volume III's institutional analysis, and the honest verdict.

openQuestions: The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

audits.scope: Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the section is a restoration, not a substitution, and the pairing test applies. Verbatim survival understates fidelity here: every R-PUNCT-STRUCT repair and recorded bounding changes the sentence it lands in, so the non-surviving remainder was read against the diff and attributed rather than assumed lost.

audits.checked: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the four pressures keep their mechanisms and the section keeps its honest verdict, the committing admission that the design has no proven answer. R-PAIRED-DELETION: professionalization, isomorphism, and constitutional culture were swept; constitutional culture pairs with the co-optation close, ends aligned. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: no recorded correction reaches this body. R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY: nothing seeded; CTD-0078 re-verified, DiMaggio and Powell named without a verification date, item open. R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: nothing kept from the shipped pass beyond the display labels held under the structural rule, no credit owed, stated explicitly. Citations re-verified intact through the repairs: the movement cycles literature dated 2011, and DiMaggio and Powell, 1983, with their three mechanisms. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-REFRAIN-COST, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: The restoration holds under the full twenty-rule index. Nine of seventeen baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder are the six em dash glyphs across three sites, the isomorphism list rebuild, the dropped run-in colon, and the colon-to-period separation, all attributed. No prose change required.
corrections: The original itemization is corrected: six em dash glyphs across three sites, all standing as comma pairs, at the movement cycles, the isomorphism definition, and the constitutional culture close. No dash became a colon; the colon after the scaling dynamics include is the baseline's own and was dropped so the enumeration runs in, kept under section 3.

Two divergences the record did not itemize, both kept: the colon at has a track record became a period, giving the verdict sentence its own weight; and the three parenthetical isomorphism glosses stand as comma appositives separated by semicolons, coercive, conforming to external requirements; mimetic, copying successful organizations; and normative, conforming to professional standards. Parentheses are not prohibited; the rebuild is consistent with the surrounding repairs and the semicolons keep the three mechanisms parallel.

The display labels The Deeper Inquiry and What Remains Open stand as Research Lineages and Open Questions, renames held under the structural rule and recorded in the standing open question on frozen labels.
